workflows..github/workflows/main.yml:
name: main
concurrency:
  group: main-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ inputs.candidate_sha || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  update-pr-branches:
    name: update PR branches
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.candidate_sha == ''
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/pr-branch-updater.yml
    secrets:
      RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
  quality:
    name: quality
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
    uses: mickey-kras/hindsight-memory-router-integrations/.github/workflows/trusted-ci.yml@e09f70355dfd69bbb31b77f590621e6b376c2f1e
    with:
      revision_sha: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
      revision_ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
  aislop:
    name: aislop
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
    uses: mickey-kras/hindsight-memory-router-integrations/.github/workflows/trusted-aislop.yml@e09f70355dfd69bbb31b77f590621e6b376c2f1e
    with:
      revision_sha: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
      revision_ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
  codeql:
    name: codeql
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
    uses: mickey-kras/hindsight-memory-router-integrations/.github/workflows/trusted-codeql.yml@e09f70355dfd69bbb31b77f590621e6b376c2f1e
    with:
      revision_sha: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
      revision_ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
  sonar:
    name: sonar
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.candidate_sha == ''
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      issues: write
    needs:
      - quality
      - aislop
      - codeql
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: step-security/harden-runner@ccd8616d44fd3846e67624a50d5aad6d37bf2d25
        with:
          egress-policy: audit
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Mask configured SonarQube endpoint
        env:
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
        run: python3 .github/scripts/mask-sonar-context.py configured
      - name: Connect to the tailnet
        uses: tailscale/github-action@d1b6cd204f8dceda5b3eaad7f1f767be390056cd
        with:
          oauth-client-id: ${{ secrets.TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID }}
          audience: ${{ secrets.TAILSCALE_AUDIENCE }}
          tags: tag:github-sonar
          use-cache: 'true'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.3
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Install SonarQube analysis dependencies
        run: |
          npm install --global npm@11.19.1 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          test "$(npm --version)" = 11.19.1
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm ci --prefix src/upstream/coding-agents --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Require successful coverage artifact
        env:
          COVERAGE_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ needs.quality.outputs.coverage_artifact }}
        run: test -n "$COVERAGE_ARTIFACT_ID"
      - name: Restore verified coverage
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.quality.outputs.coverage_artifact }}
          path: coverage
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Verify coverage provenance
        env:
          COVERAGE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: node .github/scripts/coverage-artifact.cjs verify
      - name: Mask advertised SonarQube endpoint
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
        run: python3 .github/scripts/mask-sonar-context.py advertised
      - name: SonarQube analysis
        uses: SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action@d209202bc7d53ff1cc128f7f907dac145c9d6ae9
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
      - name: SonarQube quality gate
        id: sonar-quality-gate
        timeout-minutes: 6
        uses: SonarSource/sonarqube-quality-gate-action@7a5fffe8e523c40e0c740b6bc2712ab503e52efa
        with:
          pollingTimeoutSec: 270
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
      - name: Synchronize SonarQube findings
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && failure() && steps.sonar-quality-gate.outcome == 'failure' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
          }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
        run: python3 .github/scripts/sync-sonar-findings.py .scannerwork/report-task.txt
  publish:
    name: publish packages
    needs:
      - quality
      - aislop
      - codeql
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.candidate_sha != ''
    outputs:
      released: ${{ steps.finalized.outputs.latest }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment: release-automation
    concurrency:
      group: package-release-${{ github.repository }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
      actions: read
    env:
      RELEASE_APP_ID: ${{ vars.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
      RELEASE_SETTINGS_REVIEW: ${{ vars.RELEASE_SETTINGS_REVIEW }}
      CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
      CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: step-security/harden-runner@ccd8616d44fd3846e67624a50d5aad6d37bf2d25
        with:
          egress-policy: audit
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.3
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Resolve retained packages
        id: retained
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').retryPackages({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
      - name: Restore retained packages
        if: steps.retained.outputs.artifact != ''
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ steps.retained.outputs.artifact }}
          path: packages
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Build and verify packages
        if: steps.retained.outputs.artifact == ''
        run: |
          npm install --global npm@11.19.1 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          test "$(npm --version)" = 11.19.1
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm ci --prefix src/upstream/coding-agents --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm run build
          npm run build:coding-agents
          mkdir -p packages
          npm pack --pack-destination packages --silent
          (cd src/upstream/coding-agents && npm pack --pack-destination "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/packages" --silent)
          node .github/scripts/verify-package-inventory.cjs
          sha256sum --check PACKAGE_SHA256
      - name: Verify retained package inventory
        run: |
          node .github/scripts/verify-package-inventory.cjs
          sha256sum --check PACKAGE_SHA256
      - name: Retain tested packages
        if: steps.retained.outputs.artifact == ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        with:
          name: packages-${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
          path: packages/*.tgz
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Release preflight
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').validate({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
      - name: Install release tools
        run: npm ci --prefix .github/scripts --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Candidate provenance
        id: provenance
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').candidateProvenance({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
      - name: Attest tested packages
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8
        with:
          subject-path: packages/*.tgz
          predicate-path: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.path }}
          predicate-type: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.type }}
          create-storage-record: true
      - name: Release App token
        id: app
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          permission-contents: write
          permission-pull-requests: write
      - name: Publish immutable release
        id: finalized
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          github-token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').finalize({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
      - name: Queue next version
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release-follow-up.cjs').bumpReleasedVersion({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
      - name: Delete published candidate
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          github-token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release-follow-up.cjs').deletePublishedBranch({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
'on':
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      candidate_ref:
        type: string
        default: ''
      candidate_sha:
        type: string
        default: ''
    secrets:
      RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY:
        required: false
      TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID:
        required: false
      TAILSCALE_AUDIENCE:
        required: false
      SONAR_TOKEN:
        required: false
      SONAR_HOST_URL:
        required: false
  workflow_dispatch: null
  push:
    branches:
      - main
workflows..github/workflows/pr-validation.yml:
name: PR validation
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  security-events: write
concurrency:
  group: pr-validation-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || inputs.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  guard:
    name: guard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - uses: step-security/harden-runner@ccd8616d44fd3846e67624a50d5aad6d37bf2d25
        with:
          egress-policy: audit
      - name: Read the trusted main policy
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
          path: automation
          sparse-checkout: .github
      - name: Validate PR with the trusted policy
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: |
            const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');
            const { runPolicy, runDispatchedPolicy } = require('./automation/.github/scripts/dependabot-validation.cjs');
            const mainSha = execFileSync('git', ['-C', 'automation', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
            async function runPullRequestPolicy(github, context, core, trustedMainSha, policy = runPolicy) {
              const expected = context.payload.pull_request;
              if (context.eventName !== "pull_request" || !Number.isSafeInteger(expected?.number)) {
                throw new Error("Policy job requires a pull request event");
              }
              const params = { ...context.repo, pull_number: expected.number };
              const { data: current } = await github.rest.pulls.get(params);
              if (
                current.state !== "open" || current.base.ref !== "main" ||
                current.head.sha !== expected.head.sha || current.base.sha !== expected.base.sha ||
                current.base.sha !== trustedMainSha || context.ref !== `refs/pull/${current.number}/merge`
              ) throw new Error("PR head or trusted policy revision changed");
              const files = await github.paginate(github.rest.pulls.listFiles, { ...params, per_page: 100 });
              await policy(github, context.repo, current, files);
              const { data: latest } = await github.rest.pulls.get(params);
              if (latest.state !== "open" || latest.head.sha !== current.head.sha || latest.base.sha !== current.base.sha) {
                throw new Error("PR changed during policy validation");
              }
              core.info(`#${current.number}: trusted policy passed at ${current.head.sha}`);
            }
            const run = context.eventName === 'pull_request' ? runPullRequestPolicy : runDispatchedPolicy;
            await run(github, context, core, mainSha);
  quality:
    uses: mickey-kras/hindsight-memory-router-integrations/.github/workflows/trusted-ci.yml@e09f70355dfd69bbb31b77f590621e6b376c2f1e
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
  aislop:
    uses: mickey-kras/hindsight-memory-router-integrations/.github/workflows/trusted-aislop.yml@e09f70355dfd69bbb31b77f590621e6b376c2f1e
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
  codeql:
    uses: mickey-kras/hindsight-memory-router-integrations/.github/workflows/trusted-codeql.yml@e09f70355dfd69bbb31b77f590621e6b376c2f1e
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
  branch-policy:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/branch-policy.yml
  dependabot-policy:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/dependabot-policy-tests.yml
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - ready_for_review
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      number:
        description: Dependabot PR number
        required: true
      expected_head:
        description: Prepared Dependabot commit
        required: true
workflows..github/workflows/release.yml:
name: release
concurrency:
  group: dependabot-auto-merge-${{ github.repository }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  entry:
    name: require main
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Reject release dispatches outside main
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: |
            if (context.eventName !== 'workflow_dispatch' || context.ref !== 'refs/heads/main') {
              throw new Error('Release dispatch is allowed only from main');
            }
  baseline:
    name: validate main
    needs: entry
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      security-events: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/main.yml
    secrets:
      TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID }}
      TAILSCALE_AUDIENCE: ${{ secrets.TAILSCALE_AUDIENCE }}
      SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
      SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
      RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
  prepare-release:
    name: prepare candidate
    needs: baseline
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment: release-automation
    outputs:
      sha: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.sha }}
      ref: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.ref }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    env:
      RELEASE_APP_ID: ${{ vars.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
      RELEASE_SETTINGS_REVIEW: ${{ vars.RELEASE_SETTINGS_REVIEW }}
    steps:
      - uses: step-security/harden-runner@ccd8616d44fd3846e67624a50d5aad6d37bf2d25
        with:
          egress-policy: audit
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Validate release entry point
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').dispatchContext(context);
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@594f3bf4285d9ea8dc53c9a0c9c4092420091003
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.3
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Build and verify packages
        run: |
          npm install --global npm@11.19.1 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          test "$(npm --version)" = 11.19.1
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm ci --prefix src/upstream/coding-agents --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm run build
          npm run build:coding-agents
          mkdir -p packages
          npm pack --pack-destination packages --silent
          (cd src/upstream/coding-agents && npm pack --pack-destination "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/packages" --silent)
          node .github/scripts/verify-package-inventory.cjs
          sha256sum --check PACKAGE_SHA256
      - name: Install release tools
        run: npm ci --prefix .github/scripts --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Release App token
        id: app
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          permission-contents: write
      - name: Freeze inputs and create release branch
        id: prepared
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          github-token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
          script: await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').prepare({ github, context, core });
      - name: Resolve retained preparation packages
        if: steps.prepared.outputs.sha != ''
        id: retained
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        env:
          CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.ref }}
          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.sha }}
        with:
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').retryPackages({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
      - name: Retain prepared packages
        if: steps.prepared.outputs.sha != '' && steps.retained.outputs.artifact == ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        with:
          name: packages-${{ steps.prepared.outputs.sha }}
          path: packages/*.tgz
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Resume the prepared release
        if: steps.prepared.outputs.resume_sha != ''
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        env:
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.version }}
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.resume_sha }}
          RELEASE_RUN: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.resume_run }}
        with:
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').resumePreparedRelease({
              github, context, core, version: process.env.RELEASE_VERSION, sha: process.env.RELEASE_SHA,
              runId: process.env.RELEASE_RUN ? Number(process.env.RELEASE_RUN) : undefined,
            });
  release:
    name: validate and publish candidate
    needs: prepare-release
    if: needs.prepare-release.outputs.sha != ''
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      security-events: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/main.yml
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ needs.prepare-release.outputs.sha }}
      candidate_ref: ${{ needs.prepare-release.outputs.ref }}
    secrets:
      RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
  retain-preparation:
    name: retain failed preparation
    needs: prepare-release
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.prepare-release.result == 'failure' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: await require('./.github/scripts/release-cleanup.cjs').preparation({ github, context, core });
'on':
  workflow_dispatch: null

'on':

permissions:

jobs:
